people rules › roles and employers
a person's temperament must be one its occupation (trade) or role allows. Every trade and role allows at least two, so no job reads as one kind of person (§09 risk: sameness).

§09 GENERATION
nothing hand-authored. Sky writes rules + generators. The simulation plays every generated mission before a player sees it. Build time only.
| content | from | checked by |
| people | occupation (from the trades on their block) × temperament × need × relationships × routine, fit to district schedules: the model writes cast tables per area × occupation (mixes, need weights, routine variants, tie patterns, name pools) through the levels pipeline (SurrealDB retrieval → Pulse → checker → Keel); seeded code expands them into people by plot and unit id (bun run people); accepted tables promoted to contracts/people/ with Sky's yes | people checker P-0…: reach their places in time; one clear need; only what people.rules.json allows; staff counts; ties; names; every field read by a rule; mission roles castable · same tables → same people |
| missions | template (objective, target, closing event, fight trigger) + district people | mission checker |
| dialogue, portraits, voices | person data + state (brave, resentful, promoted) | tone + rating filters; sampled review |
| district plans | Datum (roads, transit, plots, gates, levels, megastructures, frontage program) + Vantage (block layouts) inside plan.standards | plan checker exit 0 (bun tools/plan/cli.ts) |
| world | generator fills each plot from plan.standards, seeded by plot id: masses, towers, roofs, frontage trades, decks, stairs, lifts; 2–4 megastructures per district from the plan; each element dressed by a DecoKit piece (contracts/world/kit.json) or procedural to the same bar, seeded by id | plan checker (B, L, MS, F rules) · same plan → same world |
| consequences | rules on mission log | replay → same result |

people rules › positions
every work unit has exactly one keeper; the rest of its staff take the other positions of its category. A mission casts by position and place (a server on shift at the café), never by name.
food: keeper, server, cook
nightlife: keeper, server, door, entertainer
retail: keeper, assistant
trade: keeper, hand
service: keeper, operator
kiosk: keeper, attendant
cinema: keeper, usher, projectionist
lobby: keeper, porter
market: keeper
